title: SCA Minhag of the Week 163: "Bar Missvah- Celebrations & Attire"

chapters.title: Bar Misva in Syria
chapters.about: How Bar Misva celebrations were simple in Halab and Sham.

chapters.title: Development of Celebrations
chapters.about: Food given out after prayers and the shift to lavish affairs in America.

chapters.title: Dress Code and Hats
chapters.about: Suit and tie dress code and women wearing fancy hats.

chapters.title: Bat Misva Custom
chapters.about: The absence of Bat Misva celebrations in Syria and in the community.

summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the differences between Bar Misva celebrations in Syria compared to modern America. He explains how American customs like wearing suits, ties, and fancy hats for women developed, and notes that Bat Misva celebrations were not done in Syria.
questions: What was a Bar Misva like in Syria?
Did they have Bat Misva celebrations in Syria?
Where did the custom of the mother wearing a fancy hat at a Bar Misva come from?
